# Harsh Malhotra's Portfolio

## Overview

This is the personal portfolio website for **Harsh Malhotra**, a BCA student and systems engineer in Mumbai.

## Website Structure

| Path | Title | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| `/` | Portfolio | Home page with bio, skills, projects, contact |
| `/projects/weather.html` | Weather Dashboard | Interactive weather lookup portal |
| `/projects/expense.html` | Expense Tracker | Personal finance manager with charts |
| `/projects/wild.html` | Wild India | Forest & wildlife explorer with Leaflet maps |

## Technologies

- Static site: HTML, CSS (Tailwind-inspired), vanilla JavaScript
- Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans, Space Grotesk, Space Mono
- Icons: Font Awesome 6.4.0
- Maps: Leaflet.js
